svg.title: Contribution skyline
svg.desc: 682 GitHub contributions on 73 active days over 24 weeks, 2026-05-12 to 2026-10-26. Each building represents an active day. Height is proportional to contribution count. Data is a dated snapshot of the publicly visible calendar.
svg.text: PUBLIC GITHUB CALENDAR · ONE BUILDING PER ACTIVE DAY · CALENDAR DATES ARE UTC · SNAPSHOT THROUGH 2026-10-26
